nom: Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser with Salicylic Acid

avis.texte: Strong yet gentle cleanser..I use twice daily and it's not overdrying! Has reduced my break outs from my skin being stressed out with makeup. I use with clean towels, and really has improved skin! Try it!

This is my one and only face wash from now on. My skin is so soft and smooth after about two weeks of use. Breakouts have reduced as well. It's a little bit drying but a heavier moisturizer at night helps.

Been using this cleanser for about 2 weeks. I love neutrogena brand in general. After using the Evenly Clear my skin feels smoother than it has in a while. It's gentle on the skin though I did have to add a moisturizer to keep my skin from drying out.

avis.titre: Cleanser to target pores and acne
avis.texte: I have been really struggling with my skin lately. Whiteheads, blackheads, the whole nine years. My dermatologist recommended that I incorporate a salycilic acid product into my routine. Enter the Neutrogena Evenly Clear cleanser. I have been loving it so far! I use it as my morning cleanser. It has is a pretty thick, sticky consistency, but it generates a light foam when I rub it into my face. After it lathers a bit, I let it sit on my skin for 2 minutes before washing it off. My skin feels cleansed, and a little tight (in a good way) after applying. I finish it off with a light moisturizer and apply my makeup as usual! Although I need to keep usingthis product to see the full effects, after only a week or so of use, I have noticed a difference in my pores. I'm looking forward to enjoying my skin after I continue using this!

avis.titre: No different than other face wash.
avis.texte: This isn't a bad cleanser by any means. But personally there's nothing special about it that makes it stand out over any others. I haven't noticed any changes to the few post-acne scars I have, or any difference in the way it exfoliates my skin. I do agree with one of the promoted features that it is gentle on the skin.

I have oily and acne prone skin. I definitely saw less breakouts when I used this cleanser. Since it has salicylic acid, I only used it at night and 3-4 times a week as to not irritate my skin. Also I find it to be slightly drying afterwards but I find that normally happens after using actives.

The packaging is practical and easy to use, with a pump top that dispenses just the right amount of product. One pump does the trick! The cleanser itself has a smooth, thick consistency that lathers up well making it easy to apply and spread evenly. I also appreciate that it is fragrance free, which is a big plus for my sensitive skin. I am still experiencing the occasional acne flare up, thanks to hormonal changes, however, this cleanser seems to help with these breakouts without overly drying out my skin, like others tend to do. Overall, this is a solid, high-quality cleanser that delivers good results at a very reasonable price. It is a great option if you're looking for an effective, no frills, easy to use acne cleanser, without breaking the bank.

The Neutrogena Acne Cleanser exceeded my expectations. Usually products with salicylic acid are harsh on my skin,. This face wash didn't leave it dry or irritated. It left me feeling clean and fresh. The most important thing about it was getting rid of bigger pores in my T-zone and breakouts. I have combination skin and it targeted the problem areas well.
A great face wash! Makes my face and neck feel so clean. The ingredients in this product are amazing for the skin. I use it while in the shower so I can get behind my ears also. Love it!

My daughter came home from basic training and her face was broke out so received this at a great time. She tried it out a couple days and it cleared up a little bit. She said it made her face feel soft and clean.

This facewash seems to actually get my face nice and clean. Love how it foams up and you can see that it's working. I did break out when I first started ti use it but after a week or so my skin definitely got used to it. The smell isn't strong. Id almost say there's no smell to it at all. Overall id recommend.

This product is easy to use. Just wet face, lather soap in hand, scrub and raised. Leaves face feeling clean and exfoliated. Over time it helps reduce and fade an appearance of acne scars. I really like how there is artificial colors added or harms chemicals.

This product is perfect for getting rid of marks. A little too much for my every day. Great for teens daily use! I used it for a week and my face looks much better. Now the teens use it on the daily...I think i will have to keep purchasing it for them!

This Neutrogena evenly clear face wash is the perfect wash to use every morning and night. My skin can easily get dried out but I have found this wash to keep my skin feeling clean without drying it out.

I started off using the product and it makes your face feel and look mosturized that's a plus but what I noticed on the 4th day was my face started breaking out from this, my skin isn't really sensitive to products. My own personal experience is the product can break out your face instead of clearing your skin from acne leaving it smooth.

avis.titre: Honestly my new favorite face wash!!
avis.texte: This face wash definitely exceeded my expectations for sure! I could tell a difference in my skin after my first use! It was gentle on my skin, could tell my face wasn't breaking out as much after a couple of days of using it! I will definitely continue using and purchasing this! This is now my new go-to face wash

Good product at night when you are trying to do a master reset on your skin and remove dirt and oil. Once daily worked best for me as it is winter time and I want to ensure I keep my skin well hydrated. I can see using this product twice daily if you have oily skin or during the summer when you are sweating more.

Clearly amazing! I was so excited to try this product and I was not disappointed. It was nice and refreshing. Nonirritating and gentle. Light and excellent at removing makeup. This is a must have especially if you prefer products without strong fragrances.
I received this to try in exchange for my honest review. My face felt clean after using it but it also dried my skin out a little.

I truly enjoyed this cleanser! In the Winter, my face is UNBEARABLY dry. Just beyond uncomfortable. I was pleasantly surprised to find that the cleanser didn't leave me Sahara dry. There is a faint, clean scent and a gentle texture that leaves my skin actually feeling clean. Sometimes, with certain washes, it can feel like it does the bare minimum at the very surface. But the Evenly Clear feels like it actually deeply cleanses and leaves me feeling spa clean!

avis.titre: Effective Yet Gentle Acne Cleanser for D
avis.texte: I've been using the Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser and overall I'm really impressed. The clear gel formula feels lightweight and doesn't have a strong smell, which I appreciate. It lathers well and leaves my skin feeling clean without that tight, over-dry feeling some acne cleansers cause. I like that it contains 2% salicylic acid to help with breakouts, but also includes PHA exfoliant, which feels gentler on my skin. After using it, my skin looked smoother and more refreshed, and I didn't experience irritation or redness. With continued use, I noticed my skin tone looked more even and post-acne marks appeared less noticeable. This cleanser works well for daily use and feels like a good option for anyone dealing with breakouts but still wanting something gentle. I would definitely consider adding this to my regular skincare routine.

I've been using this facial cleanser for a few weeks now and I really like it! the gel foams nicely and cleans my skin thoroughly without leaving it dry or tight. I've noticed not a single breakout and my skin tone seems to even be evening out! This is a good cleanser for daily use!

The Neutrogena brand name has been a skincare staple in my home for about as long as I can remember. I'm not currently experiencing acne breakouts because of aging skin, but this would've been GREAT to have had---about 30 years ago! Thanks to Neutrogena & Home Tester Club!

I've been using the Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser for a few weeks and am impressed. It's incredibly gentle on my skin even with the salicylic acid, and doesn't leave my face feeling tight or dry. My skin feels clean, smooth, and I feel genuinely fresh faced after every wash. I've noticed fewer breakouts and a more even skin tone without irritation. It's a great balance of effective and gentle making it great for daily use. I plan on keeping this product in my skincare routine.

This cleanser was gentle and effective on my skin. It didn't have a noticeable scent or dry out my skin. It exfoliates nicely and helps with acne. My skin has been looking more clear since using this cleanser.

This cleanser easily comes out of the pulp and spreads well on my face! This product has 2% salicylic acid which helps to prevent acne! This product not only clears my acne but it exfoliates to visibly fade the look of post acne marks! I would definitely recommend this to my family and friends.

I have very acne prone skin and this was amazing for my skin. I had cleansed it without irritating my already broken out skin and it definitely helped not get further breakouts. I am very happy with this and I will continue to use this.
My skin feels so clean and refreshed after using this product. It doesn't dry my skin out at all and it can be used morning and night. I love that it has a pump which makes it so much easier to use.

My husband has been using this for a bit now. He's definitely not a product person. But I placed this in the shower knowing he would use it. He is out side all day and sometimes get acne on his back. There has been a noticeable difference in his back since he's been using this !

I am not the most loyal person when it comes to buying the same product over and over again so I have tried my fair share of facial cleansers. This one is hands down the best one I've tried to date. My skin has never been clearer since I've continued use of this product. The formula is so gentle but works hard as cleaning my face. There are no harsh smells or fragrance which I love as well. I was so impressed with the results of this cleanser and have been so happy to try it out. The pump bottle is easy to use and one pump is plenty of product. So impressed with this one and maybe I'll have to start being loyal to a certain brands product for once!

Wow to Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser, I have found my Holy Grail with this product. I have hormonal acne and hyperpigmentation. While using this cleanser my face did not purge! It was gentle on my skin but strong enough to eliminate that oily feeling after use and my skin did not feel dry. The salicylic acid and PHA exfoliant cleaned out my pores which helped prevent future breakouts. I was extremely impressed with this cleanser and have already recommended it to my friends. My post acne marks have diminished immensely and this cleanser is fragrance free which is great for sensitive skin girlies like me. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser is a good product. I'm saying it is only good & giving 4 stars because it does have a weird scent & actually dried out my face a bit. However, you only need to use a little bit so it does go.a long way and would last quite some time.

Excuse my face, I just woke up. I've used Neutrogena Evenly Clear acne cleanser for a few days now, and it is definitely gentle and still effective. I think that the combination of the salicylic acid and PHA gives light exfoliation without being harsh. That cleans my skin and rinses off easily without leaving my skin, feeling tight and dry. I have not experienced any irritation as of yet. It feels like a good option for my acne prone skin. So far so good I am happy with it.
The acne wash was a great product. It foamed up very good to put on ur face and left ur face feeling great and very refreshed

Scent is very light, not highly fragranced. Skin feels soft & smooth after use. Makeup completely washed off. No sticky film or residue left behind. Lathers easily & washes away just as easily. My face feels fresh & truly, completelyclean. Product didn't leave my face feeling irritated or dry.

This cleanser is calming down my breakouts on my skin. It's gentle and comfortable, it fights acne on my skin, but doesn't make it dry. Highly recommend if you want acne safe facial wash for every day.

This is a great cleanser. I noticed a bit of difference on my face from my previous acne just after a few days. Does a good job at washing and leaves the skin feeling fresh and clean. I would definitely recommend this acne cleanser.

This cleanser works great for my acne without drying out my skin. Feels gentle, helps reduce breakouts, and leaves my skin looking more even. I also like the easy pump bottle. Would definitely recommend.
Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser is an impressive product. I had great results. I appreciate that it was, but it isn't drying to the skin.

avis.titre: Acne Cleanser That Actually Feels Gentle
avis.texte: My wife has been using the cleaner and she was pleasantly surprised by how balanced it feels on the skin. She used it mostly at the night as part of her cleansing routine. Even though it contains 2% salicylic acid and 2% PHA, it didn't not feel harsh or overly drying.

avis.titre: Makes my skin so so soft
avis.texte: Love this face wash normally I like ones with like tiny little things in there that helps scrub. You know the dead skin off, but this I felt like a rejuvenated person using it the first time and my skin was so soft over the week man I barely had a problem with blackheads like I normally do best face wash ever not to mention it seemed to live out my complexion or at least like take the right away or something I don't know, but my whole complexion looked better
I really enjoyed this face wash. It helped my skin feel nice and clean. It helped clear my breakouts up. I can't believe how fast it helped to clear my skin.

I found it easiest to use this product in the shower. It takes little of the product to create a foam after adding water, and it goes on very easily, and covers wonderfully. Rinsing it off was a cinch also. It left my face feeling cleaner than ever. I absolutely recommend this product!
I have enjoyed trying the evenly clear acne cleanser. It leaves my face feeling so clean and fresh without being drying. It has helped clear up my skin.

I was surprised that this cleaner actually smelled nice and it didn't sting my skin as I put it on. This also didn't lather up as much as I'm used to but it left my skin fealing nice. I would recommend this

I started using Neutrogena Evenly clear in December 2025 and I'm amazed at how well it's helped my post acne scars. I'm 40, so I was a little sceptical at first, because a lot of my acne scars are from a long time ago. However, it's done a great job with helping my acne scars and my acne. I didn't find this cleanser to be drying either.
Leaves my faces feeling fresh and clean with out drying out my skin, I love how my glows using this face wash. I definitely recommend this products to friends and family.

The Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser was super easy to use. Simply wet your face, and lather the cleanser in your hands before applying to your face. Once applied, you could feel it working instantly; opening up my pores. My husband and I would use this product prior to bed to clean our faces and it worked wonders. Highly recommend.

I received this facial cleanser complimentary from Home Tester Club in exchange for my honest opinion and review. I liked how gentle this face wash was on my sensitive skin. It did a decent job of clearing up the acne I had on my chin as well. I would recommend this facial cleanser

The Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser is my new go to. I've purchased neutrogena products in the past and so I knew I was safe here. I have very sensitive skin so im a bit hesitant when using just anything on my face these days. It's perfect for an all around good cleaning and no breakouts since I started using it. Leaves my skin super soft and acne free. I use it twice a day. Mornings and at night seems to work for me. Glad I got my hands on this and will continue to use it. Thanks Neutrogena. You never disappoint!!!

avis.titre: Great for scars and doesn't dry you out!
avis.texte: I'm loving the Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser. It does exactly what it says: it cleans and exfoliates thoroughly, but my skin never feels dry or tight afterwards. I'm also impressed that I can already see a difference in my acne scars fading. It's a staple in my routine now.
This a fantastic cleanser! It cleans all my makeup off without striping my skin if it's natural hydration. Neutrogena does a fantastic job of creating fantastic products at an affordable price.

This is a nice product, not too harsh but yet seems to work. I like how it is a clear gel and doesn't get to foamy. It seems to rinse off easily and doesn't leave a residue on your skin afterwards. I use this with a facial device. I would recommend this to anyone who wants a good cleanser for their face.

This was a great product for my face. It has cleared up my acne that I was suffering from. I would definitely recommend this product to my friends and family members. This product cleared my face up within a week of using.

I received this for free in exchange for an honest review. It has a bit of an oily feel after you rinse it off but it's not terrible. I really haven't noticed an improvement in my skin. I am still breaking out about the same as I was before using it. But it hasn't gotten worse which is what a lot of others do to me.

I struggle on and off with acne so I use all kinds of products depending on what my skin needs at the time. But Salicylic Acid is one of the ingredients I always have at home because it keeps my pores from getting clogged. It dries my skin out, so I always make sure to put on a good moisturizer as soon as I finish washing my face with it. This Evenly Clear acne cleanser by Neutrogena is so great. It suds up well and feels like it's cleaning deep. And no scent. Plus, a little bit goes a long way so this cleanser will last me awhile.
I loved it so much the best cleanser I have used highly recommended cleared my skin and made it soft and felt clean no crazy fragrance which is really great ! Love this so much
This was a great cleanser to help with acne. The salicylic acid helps tremendously with texture. I enjoyed the foaming capability. I highly recommend.

My first impression of this cleanser is that it's really gentle on the skin. It doesn't leave my face feeling stripped or tights after washing. My skin usually tends to be on the oily side and I've had some harsher cleansers irritate it. The country are really helps with clearing the basics and keeping acne at Bay. Some cleansers I feel make my oiliness worse, but not this one. For every day maintenance, and from keeping you pimples from popping up, this is a 10 out of 10 It won't break up severe acne, but it won't make it worse!

This new Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser helps to clear acne, exfoliate, and visibly fade the look of post acne marks. This helps to gently cleanse the skin and contains 2% salicylic acid acne treatment. This cleanser left my skin feeling soft, smooth, hydrated, and clean. This cleanser gets a nice lather and while washing the face and you'll feel a nice cooling sensation. It's also vegan and non comedogenic. And free of fragrance, sulfates, and dyes.

I LOVE this facial cleanser! I can feel and see a difference after every use. The gel bubbles so nicely and a little goes a really long way. I can dry wipe this cleanser off and it leaves zero greasy/oil residue. My skin across my face feels pulled and tightened, I could not believe it! No chemical/harsh smells either. I'm keeping this in my morning and night routine.
I love this product! Every wash is just as refreshing as the last. I would def recommend using a moisturizer afterwards as it does tend to dry out your skin.

I've been using Neutrogena Evenly Clear Face Wash for the past few weeks and it's become a staple in my routine. It feels gentle on my skin but still helps keep my breakouts under control. I love that it doesn't leave my face feeling tight or dry after washing, and over time I've noticed my skin looks clearer and brighter. It's simple, effective, and works well with my routine. I will note that it does not smell "pretty", but it's the skin benefits that I am after anyway, so that doesn't bother me. I would recommend this cleanser to anyone that wants clear and soft skin.

I have some acne, especially some before or during my period, so I have always liked using acids in my skincare. This cleanser is really gentle on my skin as it never made my skin feel stripped after using it like some other cleansers have. I also have combination skin, so my T-zone is very oily and this definitely worked well to clear some sebaceous filaments at the end of the day. I think it's a great daily cleanser and works decently if you're only wearing sunscreen or light powder makeup (I had a little blush and eyeshadow on most times). The formula itself is a clear, runny gel that foams up well when mixed with water and rubbed. It didn't have any detectable scent or fragrance in the ingredients, which are both a great plus to me. The pump is easily locked by turning it to the left which means it lessens the chance of leaks/spills if you travel with it. Overall, I think this is a great cleanser for those with oilier skin and acne-prone skin.
This product is great I love how it makes my skin feel refreshed and clean! I use it everyday it's a must in my nightly routine

My experience with this cleanser was positive. I have very sensitive skin on my face and this cleanser did not irritate my skin. I also liked that it had a mild scent to the cleanse because I'm sensitive to fragrance. I would recommend this cleanser to my friends and family.

It's a good cleanser. I thought it would be drying and heavy duty based on the description, but it's actually pretty gentle. It still may be on the drying side for sensitive skin, but I have been able to use it everyday. Granted, I do have a full day and morning moisturizer routine and I do need a cleanser to remove my sunscreen at the end of the day. I do always use spf with this. It does act as a gentle chemical exfoliator. I will keep this in my rotation, but I'll use it every other day with a more basic cleanser in between. Even though, it's gentle, I can tell that It's a bit more than what I need right now.

Thanks to Neutrogena for the complimentary product, I had the opportunity to use Evenly Clear, an acne cleanser facial wash, and I love how clean this makes me feel after a refreshing shower. It's also unscented, which at first took some getting used to but after you realize it's probably best not to rub fragrance all over your face like my previous wash had, I started to enjoy the neutral smell it gives and the added benefits of no unnecessary chemicals. I have noticed that breakouts are less frequent, however I'm cautious over claims that this product exfoliates to fade acne marks as there is no mechanical exfoliant in the cleanser (like little beads). As such, it's reliant on chemical exfoliants which I haven't seen make any visible reduction to my marks. Regardless, from my trial of the product and seeing the effect (or rather lack of) on my sensitive skin, I would recommend this to anyone looking for a gentle acne cleanser for daily use.
I really enjoy this facial acne cleanser. It truly felt like it was cleaning my face. It forms bubbles and doesn't leave your face feeling tight or dry. I'd definitely recommend this product.

I really enjoyed using Neutrogena Evenly clear acne face wash. I have really noticed a difference in my skin. My skin is clearer and bright. My acne has gone down. My skin does not feel tight after washing it. I highly recommend this product.

I received this Neutrogena Evenly Clear face wash as a complimentary sample from Home Tester Club. It came well packaged in a pump top plastic bottle. It looks clear and smooth gel like in texture. It doesn't have any strong fragrance to it. The face wash contains 2% Salicylic acid and 2%Pha to it, so it keeps the face clear and acne free. It lathers well and leaves the face super clean, soft and glowing. I love this product and would love to recommend it.

I really liked this cleanser. It doesn't overly dry out or cause that squeaky feeling and provides a soft, gentle, clean. I also quite enjoyed that it was shipped with a plastic piece to keep it from opening and pumping. I kept it to use and take on vacation when packing. I've noticed it has helped clear up some of my acne without being very harsh. This isn't one that will lather very much but it doesn't have to to be working.

I've been using Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser for a few weeks now and I'm really happy with the results. It leaves my skin feeling clean without being overly harsh, which is something I struggle to find with acne cleansers. The salicylic acid helps keep breakouts under control, and I've noticed my skin texture looks smoother with continued use. Doesn't dry out my skin like other acne washes.
I'm pretty happy with this acne cleanser it has no scent and is showing some clearing up of my acne. No harsh chemical feel and no harsh scents. It feels clean and reminds me of Tula cleanser.

I have acne prone skin, so I am careful when trying cleansers. But the Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser has pleasantly surprised me. I appreciate that it is fragrance free, which is essential for my sensitive skin. The cleanser lathers up nicely, and it feels like it is cleaning my skin. It is effective without being too harsh. It keeps my breakouts in check, and it doesn't leave my skin feeling tight or overly dry after I rinse it off.

If you struggle with acne and acne scarring like I do you will really like this cleanser. It doesn't have a scent and just after 1 week of use the small spots of acne I had on my face completely went away.

This was a great product! It was easy to use and seemed very effective. I would highly recommend this product to anyone. I would love to see even more info on the ingredients. Overall, a great product!

Always used and love Neutrogena Products but this one is my favorite! It's very soothing and works really well at removing makeup! Cleans my pores of excess dirt and oils! Doesn't leave any residue an my skin feels soft and clean!

I'm currently loving this acne cleanser called "Evenly Clear" by Neutrogena! Not only does this cleanse my face super well and not leave it dry but it has such an amazing ingredient for acne prone skin, 2% salicylic acid! This doesn't irritate my face at all but almost refreshes it!

I really liked this cleanser. I suffer from slight acne and this controller it a bit. I liked that it has a pump so I didn't struggle getting the product out. It goes in easy. And is very easy to incorporate into your face cleaning routine.

This face wash worked great for me! I have very sensitive skin and this did not cause any irritation or redness after using once daily for a few weeks. My skin does look more smooth, and I have not had any breakouts since I started using it. I love that. There is no fragrance, the pump dispenser has worked well for me and the way lathers feels very nice on my skin. Does not cause any excessive dryness either. Would recommend!

It has a refreshing, clean scent. It lathers nicely so you don't need more than one pump. My skin feels clean but also tight after washing, something I haven't felt in awhile like with my other cleansers. I'm not sure if that's a good thing but I don't care for it. I think I'll give it to my teen.
This acne cleanser was incredibly gentle on my skin! It was easy to apply and rinse off, and did not cause any irritation afterwards. I felt it helped clear up my mild acne spots as well!

I was able to sample Neutrogena's Acne Minimizer Cleanser. I used this product to wash my face everyday. I loved the foamy action of this cleanser; ease of use and through cleaning job. I noticed it really helped reduce any acne blemishes and also helped reduce past acne marks on my face. This product really cleansed my face; helped reduce scars and kept my skin hydrated. I would highly recommend this product to my family and friends.
This works great! Exfoliating scrub and my face feel very fresh abs clean afterward. Does not leave a residue, and I feel like my acne has been slowing improving!!

I've been using this Neutrogena Evenly Clear cleanser for a little bit now and I really like how it feels. Since I have super sensitive skin, my face usually tends to burn with face washes, especially ones that have a scent. This one has a very slight floral scent that doesn't smell bad at all, and while I did feel a little sting sensation, it honestly wasn't too bad. I think it mostly depends on if I shave my face right before using it or if I use the wash first. The texture is a clear gel that lathers up super well, so you don't need much to spread over your whole face. It feels like it's deeply cleaning my pores and helping with marks without leaving my skin feeling totally stripped. The pump is also really convenient and works smoothly. I'm knocking off one star just because of that slight stinging I felt, but if you don't have sensitive skin I'd definitely recommend it!
I used this acne cleanser for about two weeks and honestly I've seen no difference in my skin. I do have sensitive skin and I noticed I can't use this daily otherwise it will start to burn.

I really enjoyed using this Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser. My face felt refreshingly clean each day after using it. I'm also happy that it did not leave my skin feeling dry, even with the salicylic acid it contains to fight acne. It's easy to apply and create a small lather, and then rinses off easily (I especially like to use it in the shower for maximum ease without making a mess around the sink). I've always trusted the Neutrogena brand and this product is no exception. I would definitely use this product again.

This cleanser has been a solid addition to my routine. My skin feels smoother but not dry and it appears more even after a few weeks use. I haven't had a breakout in almost two weeks with this. It's a great option for someone looking for a gentle but effective cleanser.

I tried this for my hormonal PMS breakouts and it worked exceptionally well, on pimples that I normally have a hard time clearing! It didn't irritate my sensitive skin & I loved that there wasn't any intense fragrance added, it just smelled clean and fresh. My only complaint was that it tends to be a bit drying, but adding a nice moisturizer after is an easy fix!
This Evenly Clear Acne Cleaner was a refreshing wash that did a good cleanse. The lather was a little less than I normally like, but id did the job it was designed for.

I have used Neutrogena products before and thought this would be another good product, which I feel is right about this one! It doesn't have a bad smell, almost scentless, but slightly clinical/clean, but barely something that pushes me away from using it. I used it on my face and started to notice a difference of where my pimple was after I popped it. It didn't burn my skin and I haven't had any issues with using other face products after washing my face like lotions, creams, and toners.

So after using this for a couple weeks I have noticed cleared up skin! I get super hormonal acne. It is a little drying to the face but I can handle that with some moisturizer but for the most part I really like this cleanser
I found it very easy to add this to my routine and the best part is that it works!! I recommend this to anyone who gets acne. My face felt so clean after using it too.
Neutrogena evenly cleanser is a good product.. especially when you have ache problems.. The product makes your skin feel great.. I recommend this product

I love this product ! It keeps my skin feeling super clean without feeling dry and tight! The smell is clean and fresh without being overbearing! It left my skin bright and clear with a little glow even! I am really impressed with this face wash!

I've been using this cleanser for a couple weeks now. I feel like it's a good cleanser, but can be better. A little goes a long way and easily helps remove my makeup. It just makes my skin feel stripped afterwards and I have to use more moisturizer than I regularly would.

avis.titre: Alleviates acne and light on the skin
avis.texte: I have used Neutrogena products for a long time to help with acne, exfoliation, and cleansing my skin (body and face). This Evenly Clear is fantastic to use because it's good for sensitive skin and really all skin types. It not only cleanses my skin and helps with acne, but it also has exfoliation properties too. I'ts unscented other than a slight chemical ingredient. This product does have Salicylic Acid, which is an ingredient I always personally look for in an acne skincare product. I'm glad to have an exfoliant that is still soft on the skin and doens't have any irritants to my skin.

Disclaimer: Not a skincare professional, just a skincare nerd. On paper, this product is perfect for my skin needs, as someone with oily, acne-prone skin. Upon first use, it seemed like I would love this product, but that quickly changed when I started to feel a tingling sensation. The culprit was menthyl lactate, a menthol derivative which you've probably experienced in a plumping gloss, and it gives a cooling sensation. Unfortunately, it's extremely uncomfortable on the face, especially if you get it near the delicate skin of your lips and eyes. This burns if it gets too close to your eyes, and it lingers for a couple minutes This wouldn't happen often, but for some reason this cleanser is very runny once it's on the skin even though it lathers quite thickly. If you enjoy the "cooling" feeling, great! But personally, this really hinders my experience. I would love this otherwise, but that sensation + the running of the cleanser doesn't make for a positive cleansing experience.
